thread:
marie: quick UX thread — noticed the new "invocation metadata" column in the playground run history is pretty dense on small widths. thinking we should trim by default and surface details on demand.

sam: +1, on a laptop it's ok but collapses badly on 1024px. could we prioritize status/duration/timestamp and hide the rest behind chevrons?

leo: suggestion: default row shows: model, status, duration, and a compact timestamp. expand reveals: input schema, tool calls, raw args, and cost. avoid showing token counts by default.

anya: accessibility nits: expanded panel currently traps focus when you open it with keyboard. keyboard users need a clear escape (Esc) and focus return to the row toggle. also aria-expanded needs to be set on the chevron button.

ken: copy tweak: the header currently says "Invocation details" — feels a bit jargon-y for new users. propose "Run details" or "Execution details". small A/B test?

marie: A/B test sounds good. experiment name: "invocation_copy_run_vs_execution". track clicks on "download JSON" and expand rates.

sam: about the JSON view — can we collapse large tool outputs by default and show a one-line summary? e.g., for tool "http_fetch" show "200 OK — 3KB" then a "show full" link that reveals the payload.

leo: related: the schema editor panel currently shows a raw JSON blob for function defs. Can we render a compact table: name | input type | return type | description? still allow raw JSON toggle.

anya: color/contrast: the chevron icon on the compact row is low contrast on dark mode; should meet AA for small UI controls. Also add focus ring visible in both themes.

ken: mobile: we should collapse the run row into a single line with an overflow menu (three dots) that contains expand/download/share. Avoid horizontal scroll.

marie: telemetry: please add metrics for expand-by-keyboard vs expand-by-click, and how often users copy schema snippets. we want to see if keyboard users rely on expand panel or the schema editor instead.

ci-bot: deploy: playground/run-history-ux tweaks deployed to staging at 2026-03-01T14:12Z (build #4871).

sam: quick UI detail — when you expand, the panel pushes content down which makes it hard to inspect multiple runs. can we make expansion overlay modal-ish or use an inline drawer that doesn't reflow the entire list?

leo: overlay would be great for quick inspect, but keep inline drawer for "compare mode" (when you select multiple runs). maybe split behaviors by modifier key: click = overlay, shift+click = inline expand.

anya: accessibility check on overlay: ensure the overlay gets initial focus and screen reader reads "Run details for <model> — dialog". add role=dialog and aria-modal=true.

marie: action items: 1) Ken — prototype overlay vs inline in Figma (small screens and desktop). 2) Sam — add aria-expanded and Esc handling in the chevron component. 3) Leo — compact table for function defs + raw JSON toggle. 4) Anya — write accessibility test plan (keyboard flows + screen reader labels). 5) Product — set up A/B for copy (Run vs Execution). I'll open a docs PR with proposed copy strings.

ken: ack, prototype ETA EOD Thursday.

sam: I'll push a tiny patch for chevron aria + Esc handling today, link coming.

leo: I'll mock the compact table and example collapsed tool-output summary (200 OK — 3KB)

anya: I'll draft the a11y test checklist and add it to the PR as a comment.

marie: perfect. thanks all — want to ship this as a Q2 polish item. :tada:
